routes.label: Add the daylight duration to sunrise

question: On February \(13\) The Oshkosh Northwester listed the length of daylight as \(10\) hours and \(24\) minutes, the sunrise as \(6:57\text{ AM},\) and the sunset as \( 8:15\text{PM} .\) The length of daylight and sunrise were correct, but the sunset was wrong. When did the sun really set?
solution: Sunset occurs \(10\) hours and \(24\) minutes after sunrise. Ten hours after \(6{:}57\text{ AM}\) is \(4{:}57\text{ PM}\). Of the remaining \(24\) minutes, \(3\) minutes reach \(5{:}00\text{ PM}\), leaving \(21\) minutes. The sun therefore set at \(\boxed{5{:}21\text{ PM}}\), choice \(\boxed{\text{B}}\).
